cases.prompt: 用户只上传原片并提到蜘蛛侠；按长期规则生成原创都市漫画英雄转绘请求。
assertions: selection.style_id equals original-urban-comic-hero
selection.ip_reframing_performed equals true
selection.selection_source equals user-explicit
selection.gender_inference_performed equals false
provider message excludes named IP and exact protected designs
external submission and credits remain unconfirmed before user approval
cases.human_notes: 请求合同证明没有自动性别分类，不证明真实视频生成质量。

cases.prompt: 用户要求宫崎骏风格手势框视频。
assertions: style id maps to warm-handpainted-fantasy-anime
provider message describes medium, palette, light, motion and mood
provider message does not name Miyazaki or Studio Ghibli
cases.human_notes: 这是请求转译测试，不是艺术相似度评价。

cases.prompt: 前段双手还没张开时让遮罩是一条线，并跟随指尖连续展开成四边形，不要突然出现。
assertions: two detected hands produce a tracked quad without a minimum spread gate
near-degenerate finger geometry is stabilized to a renderable thin line
line, opening and open phases remain visible
corners follow thumb and index tips continuously
default is used only when both hands are unavailable beyond the hold window
preview and renderer consume the same continuous geometry
cases.human_notes: 细线厚度和手部检测稳定性仍需在真实视频中观看；快速动作、遮挡或特殊手势可能需要人工关键帧。

cases.prompt: 把与原片对齐的风格化视频通过双手框显示，不要把视频扭曲塞进框里。
assertions: review config fit_mode equals clip
inside_loop equals false
overlay is resized once to the full output frame
hand quadrilateral is used only as a visibility mask
perspective compose mode is rejected
inside and source use the same timeline position
cases.human_notes: 空间对齐的自动测试不替代真实视频逐帧观看；生成模型若改变人物位置，遮罩合成仍会错位。

cases.prompt: 用合成原片与合成转绘片验证请求、媒体 QA、AI 转绘勾选、四角审核、渲染和成片合同。
assertions: transform request and verification are copied into project
inside_origin.route equals ai-video-edit
gender_inference_performed equals false
transform_review.approved is required before confirmation
fit_mode equals clip and the transformed layer is not perspective-warped
final output duration and resolution match source
provider_backed remains false for recorded fixture
cases.human_notes: 合成夹具不能证明真实平台的原创角色或手绘动画转绘质量。

cases.prompt: 用一条人物原片制作原创角色手势框视频，并把本次验证过的成功顺序应用到下一次制作。
assertions: provider-supported integer duration is resolved before transformation
one non-destructive integer-duration source remains the timeline identity for generation tracking review and render
provider request preserves camera composition body motion hand trajectory and timing while changing only original character and matching environment
misaligned transformed video is rejected rather than repaired with perspective warp
two-hand geometry preserves line opening and open phases without an area gate
human approval covers both the transformed video and the hand-window track
final output is spot-checked at absent line opening open and late-motion moments
missing provider trace remains explicitly non-provider-backed
cases.human_notes: 这些规则来自一个已通过用户审核的真实 10 秒项目；不能据此宣称跨视频、跨模型或商业用途稳定。

cases.prompt: 同一条 11 秒人物原片生成六个明显不同的原创角色转绘，手框完全展开后每 1–2 秒按顺序切换。
assertions: every style is generated as a complete source-duration transformed video
replacement prompts permit visible changes to face shape hair makeup costume material and character identity
motion skeleton body placement head and shoulder anchors hands fingertips camera and timing remain aligned
rotation begins at the first open hand-frame phase and divides the remaining duration across all styles
every transformed video is sampled at the composition global time and never restarted on a style switch
transitions use a short crossfade and the last style holds to the end without looping
every transformed video has a separate review approval and identity check
cases.human_notes: 代码测试与本次五条真实回传视频证明轮换、时间合同和像素级差异代理；角色身份、审美、动作稳定性和视觉质量仍需逐条人审。

cases.prompt: 手部在 7 秒附近旋转，使上边和下边交叉；保留真实动作，不要稳定成普通凸四边形。
assertions: corner identity remains left index right index right thumb left thumb
self-intersecting tracking keyframes are valid and are not angle-sorted convexified or cyclically reindexed
renderer reports semantic-fingertip-bow-tie crossing frames and times
final verification fails when tracking contains crossing keyframes but the render reports no crossing frames
human review compares source and output before any local smoothing
cases.human_notes: 运行时门禁证明交叉几何进入渲染代码路径；交叉是否准确贴合手指仍需人工观看交叉前、中、后三段。

cases.prompt: 五条转绘片按顺序轮换，避免误用重复文件或几乎相同的画面。
assertions: all transformed videos are sampled pairwise at matching global times
each pair records mean absolute pixel delta and sample deltas
minimum pairwise delta must meet the configured proxy threshold
report labels the metric as a proxy rather than character identity proof
human approval remains mandatory for identity and aesthetic difference
cases.human_notes: 像素差异可以发现重复或近似重复素材，但不能判断两个角色是否都好看、是否只是换装或是否符合用户审美。
